The '''1956 [[German football championship]]''' was the culmination of the [[Association football|football]] season in [[West Germany]] in [[1955–56 Oberliga|1955-56]]. [[Borussia Dortmund]] were crowned champions for the first time in their second final appearance, having previously lost the [[1949 German football championship]] final to [[VfR Mannheim]].<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duitchamp.html (West) Germany -List of champions] rsssf.org, accessed: 19 December 2015</ref><ref>[http://www.weltfussball.de/teams/borussia-dortmund/1/ Borussia Dortmund » Steckbrief] {{in lang|de}} Weltfussball.de – Borussia Dortmund honours, accessed: 19 December 2015</ref>

On the strength of this title, the club participated in the [[1956–57 European Cup]], where it went out to [[Manchester United]] 3–2 on aggregate in the quarter-finals.

==Competition==

===First qualifying round===
The four qualified runners-up played two qualifying rounds to determine the three clubs which advanced to the group stage. The deciding game for the third qualified team had to be replayed after a three-all draw after extra time in the first match.

{{OneLegStart}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[FC Schalke 04|Schalke 04]]'''|| 2–1 aet |[[Hannover 96]]||}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[VfB Stuttgart]]'''|| 8–0 |[[TuS Neuendorf]]||}}
